entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex... I hope you can help me. I got a VeloBand Cadence Sensor about a week and a half ago, and... I just need to return it. I'm so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're disappointed with your new VeloBand. Just to confirm, are you referring to the new VeloBand Pulse model?
Yes, that's the one. The Pulse. I was so excited for it.

Okay, I have your account pulled up. I can certainly look into the return options for you. First, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with how it works?

It's not broken... it's just so confusing. I really expected more from it. The whole interface is hard to use, and I can't get it to show me what I want. I've been a loyal customer for years, and this is the first time I've felt this let down.

I understand your frustration, and I appreciate your loyalty to VeloFit. It's important to us that you're happy with your gear. Before we discuss the return, I want to address the policy. I see your Pulse was delivered 12 days ago. Because the VeloBand Pulse links directly to your account upon activation, it has a strict 10-day return window. So, unfortunately, we are outside the timeframe for a refund.
Oh, no... just by two days? I really needed this money back for a bill that just came up. I read the user manual and I just can't get it. This is really upsetting.

I do apologize for the difficult position that puts you in. I know this is frustrating, but perhaps I can help solve the issue you're having with the display. You mentioned it's hard to use. Can you give me an example of a feature that isn't working the way you thought it would?

Well, I want to see my live cadence zones while I'm actually riding. It just shows me the raw number, and I have to wait until I'm done and look at the app to see how I did. What's the point of a live display if it doesn't show that?

That is a fantastic question, and I have great news for you. That's a feature you can absolutely customize. It sounds like your device is still on the factory default screen. We can change that right now in the VeloFit app if you have your phone handy.
Really? The user manual didn't make that clear. Okay, I have my phone... what do I do?

Perfect. Open the VeloFit app, tap on the 'My Devices' tab, and select your VeloBand Pulse. From there, you should see an option for 'Live Display Settings.' If you tap that, you can actually drag and drop the different data fields. You'll see one called 'Cadence Zone Graph'.
Hold on... My Devices... Live Display Settings... Oh my gosh. There it is. I'm dragging it onto the main screen now.
Excellent. Now just make sure to hit 'Save' and sync your device. The next time you ride, your VeloBand Pulse will display that live zone data, exactly as you wanted.
Wow. Okay, that... that actually solves my entire problem. I was so convinced it was just a basic display. I feel a bit silly now, but that's so much better. Thank you.

Not at all! It's a powerful device, and it can take a moment to get everything set up just right. I'm really happy we could find a solution that makes the product work for you. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
No, that was it. You've been a huge help, Alex. I really appreciate you taking the time to walk me through that. I'm actually excited to use it now.
I love to hear that. Enjoy your next ride with the new display! Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
